title: Travis Walton case dismissed as fabrication

tellings.quote: think he just made it But I think he was just late uh getting the job done. And he didn't pass a lie detector test, by the way. I was on a show with him.

related.note: Same 1975 Travis Walton abduction, but the core claim is different: Shermer says it was made up and points to a failed lie detector test.

plain: Travis Walton, a man who said he was taken by a UFO in 1975, made the story up, according to the well-known skeptic Michael Shermer, who suggests the reason was that Walton was running late getting a job done. Shermer adds that Walton did not pass a lie detector test, and says he was once on a show with him. If he is right, one of the best-known abduction cases would be a cover story for a missed deadline.
